  ns/byte: wall-clock time per ADC payload byte on one thread. allocs/frame: operator new
  calls in the timed region / frames converted. x (a): how many times faster than (a), by
  median ns/byte. Replay rows include the driver's FrameAssembler (byte-offset placement,
  core-11 P1; flushed at end of stream), identical for every variant. drv_* rows (d) run the
  driver's DCA1000Handler instead (no flush: a clean tail closes the last frame). Every replay
  row must complete exactly the requested number of frames ("= golden"). Compare variants
  within a row group, not across groups.
